evals.prompt: We finished the core domain chart yesterday (ddd/04-strategize is done). Now I want to work out how the bounded contexts actually talk to each other for the main scenarios — place order, cancel order, and the restock policy that crosses into inventory. Draw the flows, tell me where things should be sync vs async, and ask me where you're unsure.
evals.expected_output: Resolves ./ddd, runs in interactive mode at the manifest depth, runs ddd connect inputs and reads decompose/strategize/discover, presents an inputs check (distance hint from scale_target, cross-context policies found, scenarios chosen), drafts connect.json, renders the mermaid sequence diagrams with ddd connect render, reviews the flows with at most 4 targeted questions (sync vs async, policy host, missing alternative path), then the integration decisions and coupling concerns with at most 4 questions, writes ddd/05-connect/connect.json and message-flows.md, passes ddd validate --step connect, marks the step done via ddd mark, and closes with a summary naming /ddd-organise as the next step.

evals.prompt: Run ddd-connect on /Users/me/projects/labtrack/ddd in auto mode, depth standard, no questions — the orchestrator will pick up organise next.
evals.expected_output: No questions asked. Produces 4–7 flows (happy path, boundary-crossing alternatives, one per cross-context policy) with steps referencing only bounded-context, actor and external-system ids; a complete message catalogue reusing discover command/event ids and new kebab-case ids for queries; one integration_patterns entry per decompose relationship with mechanism, assumed_distance and rationale consistent with the scale target; coupling_concerns with severity/smell/mitigation; every guess logged in assumptions[] and every unasked question in open_questions[]. ddd connect render --check reports OK, ddd validate --step connect passes with 0 errors, ddd mark records done (or draft if a blocking question remains), and the final message lists absolute paths, key findings and /ddd-organise.

evals.prompt: Should the ordering service call inventory synchronously to reserve stock, or just publish order-placed and let inventory react? We're aiming for 3 services max and inventory is a thin wrapper over the warehouse system.
evals.expected_output: Recognises this as a ddd-connect integration decision, finds the existing ddd/ workspace (or explains that decompose/strategize are prerequisites and offers to run them), applies the pattern-by-distance table (scale target 1–3 → same deployable by default; wrapper over an external system → likely separate; sync only if ordering needs the reservation result to continue), recommends an event-driven flow with an explicit reservation-failed alternative or a sync reserve-stock query if the customer must see availability immediately, records the decision as an integration_patterns entry plus flows/messages in connect.json with an assumption about the deployment distance, re-renders message-flows.md, validates, and points to /ddd-organise to confirm the deployable split.
